name: Absorption
description: Convert damage to Health determined by a specific damage type.

name: Cover
description: Covered behind larger objects or obscuration, defense die increases by 1 size if partial cover, 3 sizes if greater cover (does not benefit from flanking creatures).

name: Elevated
description: Base die for ranged attacks increases by 1 size against targets below, and melee attacks deal Critical Hit when executed from a significant height difference, such as leaping down from an elevated surface, to a target below.

name: Hidden
description: Unseen and unheard by target until seen or detected. Increases all base die by 2 sizes.

name: Immunity
description: Reduce damage to zero determined by a specific damage type.

name: Prone
description: Base die for ranged attacks and Defense Dice against ranged attacks increases by 1 size, but your Defense Dice decreases by 1 size against melee attacks.

name: Resistance
description: Reduce damage by half determined by a specific damage type.

name: Soak
description: Functions as an extra set of Health points. When damaged, deduct from Soak before real Health points. Soak disregards Vulnerability. Multiple Soak sources don't stack; the highest value source replaces the rest.

name: Toughness
description: Immune to a specific threshold of damage.
